lead: A `-p nvs-db` test cannot build a `PgConn`, because its `wire` field is `Wire` at the default type parameter.
body: Anything reachable only through an inherent method on `PgConn` needs a socket and a certificate, and a unit test has neither. Write the sequencing as a free function generic in the stream (`start_statement(wire, state, ...)`, `reset_session(wire, state)`) with `PgConn`'s method a two-line delegation; `pg.rs`'s `Peer` then scripts a server for it with no socket, as `authenticate` already does.
